thread:
maria_sales: Quick sync  Prospect asking: SAML SSO, SCIM delta + bulk import, Okta group->role mapping, delegated admin for HR, domain TXT verification. Need buyer blurb + security line for procurement.

dan_engineering: We support SAML 2.0 (SP/IdP), SCIM 2.0 with bulk import then delta. Hosted default SCIM rate ~150req/s; Dedicated reserves throughput for ramps.

priya_se: Buyer blurb: "Redwood supports SAML 2.0, SCIM 2.0 (bulk + delta), and IdP group->role mappings. For predictable large onboardings we recommend Dedicated or Hosted with a provisioning quota add-on."

kevin_security: Security blurb: "We do not store plaintext passwords or national IDs. SCIM attributes are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and in transit (TLS1.2+). Customer-managed KMS/HSM available for Dedicated/Private."

dan_engineering: Nested groups: we flatten membership by default; can include ancestry metadata on request but recommend a sample Okta export to validate scale.

tyler_pricing: Pricing: base provisioning band + per-active-user bands; ramps can be covered by a temporary reserved-throughput add-on or Dedicated commitment. For estimates we need expected active user count and ramp cadence.

maria_sales: Great  I'll send purchaser blurb + security bit and ask for sample SCIM export and ramp dates. Thanks all.
